Author: J. Uma Devi

 The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.292 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/A.1, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, "the Act").

Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act.

entities.text: Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in F.I.R registered under the similar provisions of the Act.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned criminal petition and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act as against the petitioner/A.1.

opennyai_summary.facts: This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/A.1, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, "the Act").
opennyai_summary.decision:
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in a Criminal Petition No.6205 of 2019 filed by the petitioner therein, this Court passed an order dated 22.10.2019, quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act.
Following the order passed in the aforementioned criminal petition and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act as against the petitioner/A.1.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
